breakers.what: A character falls from standing to lying flat on the floor in one frame, with nothing in between; the lying body lands up to a body length to the side of where they stood.

During a pose change you see two copies of the same character at once, one fading out and one fading in, often side by side or offset: two Paines, two Rikkus, two Yunas (one lying, one standing), two Shivas, two Yojimbos.
Two Bahamuts at once: the dragon fades out on the left while a second one fades in about a third of the screen to the right, so it looks like it teleports through a double exposure.
Rikku shrinks when she gets ready: her idle figure is clearly taller, and her ready pose is about a third shorter, with her head well below where it was.

Some characters come out bigger in the next pose: Wakka grows when he drops to critical, Auron is bigger in his follow-through than in his swing, and gunner Yuna looks larger in her ready pose than in idle.

breakers.what: A big figure jumps sideways in one frame when its pose changes: Ifrit's KO pose appears about 200 px over, Valefor's KO lands to the side, Yunalesca jumps a quarter screen, the right fin and the Vegnagun tail swing to new places with nothing in between, and Sandy goes from floating upright to lying sideways off to the right.
Yuna's feet move across the floor while she puts an item away (the new pose stands to one side), and gunner Yuna's feet lift above the floor line when she gets ready.

The camera jumps between framings: in Anima it flips back and forth between two framings over three frames, so Tidus snaps left and right; Ormi's close-up cuts straight to a wide shot; Sinspawn Genais pops in over the party and then the whole shot jumps to another view.
Things appear out of nothing in one frame: a Yu Pagoda appears out of a white flash with no fade, and Overdrive Sin is missing for three frames and then its head is suddenly in place.

Interface panels sit on top of characters: the party HP bars hide Yuna's lower half while she takes Left-Arm Strike, Auron stands half-faded behind the Tidus bar, Bahamut's lower body is covered by the chain counter and enemy-move card, and Omnis's enemy-intent text runs across the fight.
Characters pile on top of each other: in Omnis, Wakka, Yuna and Auron stand in one heap in front of Omnis's tentacles; in Flux, Auron's whole attack happens behind Yuna, so you barely see it.
Bosses do damage from across the field: Braska's Final Aeon's Left-Arm Strike puts 2402 on Yuna while the aeon stays on its side, and Paragon hits Yuna for 1561 from far away.
Mid-fight in Isaaru, the whole scene is washed out grey, HUD included, with only Yuna in full colour and a cut-off figure at the right edge.
